svg.title: Autoware with an independent safety monitor: concept illustration
svg.desc: Concept illustration, not output of the system. A white robotaxi on unmodified Autoware approaches a crosswalk in a city street; other cars are shown with the boxes a perception stack draws around them. Autoware's planned path is red (rated QM). The independent safety monitor's envelope, the vehicle's swept path over its stopping distance, is blue (ASIL D) and ends at a stop wall before a pedestrian on the crosswalk. A parked minivan hides the kerb; the monitor limits speed so the vehicle can stop for someone stepping out. A dashed geofence marks the edge of the operational design domain: roads ≤ 30 mph (proposed), rain ≤ 2.5 mm/h, visibility ≥ 200 m. The safety monitor is not built yet; everything is a draft for engineering review.

g.text: Autoware drives. An independent safety monitor checks every command.
Something is in the swept path: geometry, not classification
SG-02 · SG-06 · FSR-06.01 · ASIL D · DQ-017 A
